# Harbor Lane Mutual policy guide

This guide explains the home policies that Harbor Lane Mutual sells. It is written for callers who want a short answer. Every section below stands on its own.

## Water damage

Sudden and accidental water damage is covered. A burst pipe, an overflowing washing machine or a failed water heater all count as sudden damage. The policy pays to dry the home and to repair what the water ruined.

Gradual damage is not covered. A slow leak under a sink that rotted the cabinet over several months is maintenance, not a claim. Mould that grew over a season is treated the same way.

### Burst pipes in winter

Pipes that freeze and burst are covered when the home was heated. If the home was left empty and unheated for more than four days, the claim is declined. Keep the thermostat at 12 degrees or more when you travel.

### Sewer backup

Sewer backup needs the optional backup rider. Without the rider, water that comes up through a floor drain is excluded. The rider costs forty dollars a year and covers up to ten thousand dollars.

## Theft

Theft from the home is covered after a police report is filed. Give the claims desk the report number when you call. Items stolen from a car are covered up to one thousand five hundred dollars.

- Jewellery is covered up to two thousand dollars without a schedule.
- Bicycles are covered up to one thousand dollars.
- Cash is covered up to two hundred dollars.

## Deductibles and payments

The standard deductible is five hundred dollars per claim. A claim below the deductible is not paid, but it is still recorded. Payments go out by bank transfer within ten business days of approval.

| Policy line | Deductible | Payment time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HO-3 | 500 dollars | 10 business days |
| HO-4 | 250 dollars | 7 business days |
